facts.business: Syncom Formulations (India) Limited manufactures and trades pharmaceutical formulations including tablets, capsules, liquids, injectables, ointments, and dry powders for domestic and export markets.
key_risks: Dependence on export markets for majority of revenue
Concentration of manufacturing at single facility in Pithampur
Regulatory compliance risks in pharmaceutical manufacturing
Foreign exchange fluctuation risk on export earnings
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include remuneration to key managerial personnel and transactions with entities where directors are interested. Details disclosed in notes to financial statements.
